scope: Extend the shared fold control to every data/information Panel callsite while keeping actions reachable.
changes: Annotations, workspace/company setup, simulated invitations, joint-responsibility details, internal-request composition, and the legacy closure report now expose the shared accessible fold control.
The annotation and internal-request header actions remain available while their panel body is folded.
All Panel callsites in App.tsx and src/components now opt into the fold control; forms that appear only after an explicit request remain initially expanded.

staticPanelInventory.method: TypeScript JSX AST scan for Panel elements without a collapsible prop in src/App.tsx and src/components

limits: Automated Chromium accessibility-tree and keyboard checks are not a screen-reader acceptance or WCAG certification.
Visual density and usability still require final product acceptance.
